title: Sold, archived and disposed inventory
summary: Find items that have left the active list, and run stock audits.

steps.text: The sidebar also lists {sold}, {arch} and {disp}: the same inventory screen filtered to that status.
Open {audits} to count stock on hand and compare it against the system quantities.
You can also ask the assistant what was sold, archived or disposed of, or to restore an item or start a stock audit. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
